notes: For girls only. Past host companies named on the page include PepsiCo, Edwards Lifesciences and Disneyland Resort. Confirm dates with Girls Inc. first. The 2026 host flyer says girls get a minimum of 50 hours of training; the page says up to 40, so ask Girls Inc. which is current.
name: Girls Meet the Workforce Externship
what_you_do: Girls in grades 9 to 12 get up to 40 hours of job training. Then 11th grade girls do a four-week externship at a local company with a mentor.
who_can_apply: Girls in 9th to 12th grade. The four-week externship is for 11th grade girls.
pay_detail: Free to join. The page does not say the externship is paid.
duration: Four-month program with a four-week externship (the 2026 externship was in July)
deadline_text: Student sign-up dates are not on the page. The 2026 host company sign-up deadline was Mar 26, 2026 (per the 2026 host flyer).
how_to_apply: The program page has a Contact Us link. Ask the Girls Inc. Programs Team how girls sign up.
